How To Use Coinbase

asr.full_text: Coinbase is a cryptocurrency exchange that allows you to buy, manage and sell cryptocurrency. We'll show you how to set up your account, navigate the app, invest and withdraw money. This video is about how to use the Coinbase platform, not how to you. Use the clickable sections below to skip to each part. Download and open the Coinbase app on your phone. For this video, we'll be using the iPhone app. Fill in your details and follow the prompts to set up your account. Verify your email address and phone number and continue to complete your details Your details are a legal requirement so be sure to use correct information You'll recieve an email once verified It should take just a few minutes Continue following the prompts until you reach the Coinbase homepage Now click here to add your payment method You can link a Paypal account a bank account or a credit or debit card fill in your details and click add now you're ready to start using coinbase on the home page you'll find a watchlist of cryptocurrency prices and some of the biggest moving cryptos here. At the bottom, you can scroll through relevant news articles. Tap the horizontal lines to find your profile settings and actions below. Tap the bell icon here to pull up your notifications. Tap the portfolio icon to check your balances. The arrows icon pulls up a quick menu with actions to buy, sell, convert, send and receive crypto. Tap trade to find all tradable cryptocurrencies on Coinbase. You can track all your assets and see how they're performing here. Get more from Coinbase by tapping on For You and find relevant news articles and advice pages. To invest in crypto using the Coinbase app, click on Trade. Under the Tradeable tab, you'll find all the cryptocurrencies you can invest in through Coinbase. Scroll and press on them to see how they're performing in their price or search for one here. As examples for this video we'll be Buying Bitcoin. To buy Bitcoin find or search for it, click on Trade and then Buy BTC to pay with cash. Tap the amount you want to spend, or the three dots to specify how much. An order preview will appear. You can see the Coinbase fees shown here. Tap buy now to process. Tap on portfolio to view the value of the cryptocurrency. To sell crypto, tap on the arrows icon and then Sell. Your cryptocurrencies will be listed here. Tap on the one you want to sell and then max to sell it all. and you can always use other currencies that you would like it to be. You can choose your cryptocurrency, such as the Pidgin or the Zipkin. Once in the crypto space, where you want to be considered, you can switch from Zipkin to Coinbase, and it's only worth the amount that you pay for it. Your cryptocurrencies will be listed here, tap on the one you want to sell, tap the arrows icon and then convert. Tap here to select the crypto you're converting. Tap here to select the crypto you want it converted to. Type the amount you want to convert then preview convert. You can see the coinbase fees shown here. Tap Convert to complete. To withdraw money you need to have your bank account linked. Tap on the three lines icon and then profile and settings. Tap add a payment method and then select US Bank account. Add your bank details and then verify your account, you'll see bank details appear. You'll need to send a small amount of money to this account using the reference given here to verify your account. The verification process will take one to two business days. Once your account is verified you'll receive an email to say that Coinbase has received your deposit. Tap on VIEW DEPOSIT and you'll see the amount you sent added to your portfolio. To withdraw, tap on your USD account then cash out. Tap the amount you want to withdraw Select your bank account and continue. The fee will be shown here.
